caption: A scalar threads across a list

expr: [Multiply, [List, [List, a, b], [List, c, d]], [List, x, y]]
expected: [List, [Add, [Multiply, a, x], [Multiply, b, y]], [Add, [Multiply, c, x], [Multiply, d, y]]]
wolfram.note: Times({{a,b},{c,d}}, {x,y}) -- we compute a matrix-vector dot product ({a*x+b*y, c*x+d*y}); Wolfram threads elementwise by its Listable attribute instead, multiplying row i by x_i ({{a*x,b*x},{c*y,d*y}}). Two different, both defensible, definitions of `*` over mismatched nested-list shapes.
sage.note: Ours multiplies a matrix by a vector as a matrix product; the Sage template is elementwise, as Wolfram's Times is.
sympy.note: Ours multiplies a matrix by a vector as a matrix product; the oracle's Multiply is elementwise, as Wolfram's Times.
